description:
IT Support Engineer


Company Overview

K2 Corporate Mobility is an independent global mobility expert, providing comprehensive services to corporate clients relocating their employees. We manage and deliver services through our global partner network and strive to be a true business partner – an extension of our clients’ HR/Mobility function. We provide one accountable point of contact for HR teams and assignees throughout international relocations.

K2 serves every location worldwide via our regional hubs located in the USA, UK, Brazil, France, Sweden, South Africa, UAE, Singapore, and Australia.

The role

The IT support role is critical to keeping the business running and growing at K2. You will provide IT services and support for K2 employees globally with a primary focus on the growing K2 teams. This can include management and support of laptops, mobile devices and software, as well as office network infrastructure. You will be the first point of contact to colleagues across the organization, triaging IT helpdesk tickets and providing basic IT support and administrative tasks. You will be also involved in other I.T related tasks and projects also, including but not limited to: building and setting up hardware servers and cloud administration, as well as other I.T related projects.

As well as excellent technical skills this role needs strong analytical skills. You will be a direct contributor to K2 achieving its next chapter of growth with technology as a key enabler of the business strategy. As a result the role offers career growth with more system and technical strategy ownership as knowledge of the system and technology offering increases.

Main duties and responsibilities

  • Be first point of contact for IT Support for the teams across K2
  • Support and assist the global IT team in day-to-day operations
  • Take ownership of user problems and be proactive when dealing with issues
  • Identify and troubleshoot hardware & software issues
  • Support in the testing and roll-out of new hardware and software
  • Building and configuring hardware
  • Contribute to best practices for the global IT Support team
  • Opportunity to learn and understand AWS deployments
  • Becoming L1 support for the two main applications: Ascent and Workspace.
  • Excellent people skills to interact with staff, colleagues and cross-functional teams

Experience: Skills / Abilities & Knowledge

  • Experience working within an IT Support Function
  • Experience in Microsoft 365, Microsoft Azure and AWS
  • Knowledge of Windows and Mac Operating Systems
  • Understanding of I.T Security
  • Networking (DNS, DHCP, VPN, Firewalls)
  • Professional customer service skills
  • Ability to work well under pressure and respond effectively to technical issues
  • Can do attitude with flexible attitude to adapt to the department's needs
  • Teamwork

Requirements

  • +2 years of relevant technology experience
  • Good level of English Language
  • Adaptable both to our team and our clients needs
  • Displaying a positive learning attitude

Working Conditions

  • 8 h/working day +1 hour lunch brake
  • 2 days/week working at our office together with all the team
  • 23 days of holiday/year
  • The position is open for both Individual Working Contract (IWK) or
  • Commercial Contracts (PFA,B2B)
  • The estimated monthly NET salary for IWK is 6 500-7 000 RON
